svg.aria-label: A Claude Code window. In the lead tab, the user types: Build a signup flow: an API, a web form and tests. The lead offers to hire a team of three, api, web and tests, and the user says yes. Three new tabs open and three tasks appear, one per member, and go to work. web stops on a question, and the lead brings it to the user: Should the form also offer Google sign-in? The user answers: Email only for now. web goes back to work, all three tasks reach done, and the lead reports: All 3 tasks done. Ready for your review.
